policy.pass_requires: observed execution on the real product/runtime path
policy.provider_and_mouse_requirements: live provider and mouse-capable terminal surface

results.detail: Rejected placeholder model with an actionable setup message; no provider or credential was fabricated.

results.evidence: Release binary launched in a real PTY with LBE_RUNTIME=real
results.detail: Visible Ratatui surface rendered, mouse capture was enabled, and terminal restore sequences were emitted on exit.

results.evidence: Real PTY launch with wall root, target workspace, database, and no session id
results.detail: Runtime displayed LBE_SESSION_ID is not configured. The launcher now bootstraps this when a real provider configuration exists.

results.evidence: Injected ? and Escape bytes into the real PTY
results.detail: Bytes were delivered and the terminal restored, but the captured PTY stream did not provide reliable semantic proof that the shortcut state changed.

results.evidence: Real release PTY SGR mouse sequences captured through LBE_INPUT_TRACE_FILE
results.detail: Observed landing click -> mouse_enter_landing and command-palette click -> mouse_command_palette_select index=0. This PASS is limited to those two paths; provider/model/session/workspace/approval click and wheel paths remain separately unverified.

results.evidence: Source hit-testing exists, but no real attached-session PTY observation is recorded
results.detail: Provider, model, session, workspace-row, approval, and wheel outcomes require an attached runtime with visible rows and must not inherit the landing/palette result.

results.evidence: No real reasoning-provider.json is present in the workspace
results.detail: Provider selection, prompt submission, tool execution, authorization, validation, and completion receipts cannot be machine-proven without a configured live provider.

blocking_items: Create a real reasoning-provider.json with a reachable provider endpoint and model id.
Rerun launch-lbe.ps1 and capture an attached session plus a real provider turn.
Run the attached-session interaction matrix on a mouse-capable terminal and record provider/model/session/workspace/approval/wheel outcomes.
